summary: Frontend-only round on Admin Content Management (/admin/content) multi-curriculum placement (Phase 1). Tested the 4 previously-untested scenarios: (1) Subtopic dialog placement picker + validation + edit re-open pre-fill, (2) Content item cascading Topic->Subtopic picker + validation + edit re-open pre-fill, (3) Admin tree curriculum-filter grafting both directions, (4) single-curriculum regression sanity + drag-and-drop reorder + grade filter. ALL 4 SCENARIOS PASSED. Only one pre-existing non-blocking React console warning-level error was observed. All test data created during the run was deleted and verified removed from Mongo (content_topics/content_items contain no TEST_QA_* docs; seed TEST_MM_TopicA/B left intact).
action_items: LOW: Fix React console error 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' fired on every topic/subtopic selection — setSearchParams() is called from inside the _setSelectedTopic state-updater callback (ContentManagement.jsx ~L550-580). Move the URL sync into a useEffect or compute the next topic outside the updater. Non-blocking (no functional impact observed) but it pollutes the console on every click.

LOW/UX: In the Content dialog's 'Placement for <Curriculum>' box, if the chosen Topic has zero subtopics tagged with that curriculum (e.g. TEST_MM_TopicB), the Subtopic dropdown opens with no options and no guidance. Mirror the existing amber 'No topics are tagged with ...' hint for the subtopic level so the admin knows why it is empty and cannot be saved.
LOW/maintainability: ContentManagement.jsx is 2710 lines — split CurriculumOverridesPanel, the dialogs and the tree/filter helpers into separate modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified in code + UI: cleanCurriculumOverrides strips the transient `_topic_hint` before every POST/PUT, and the edit dialog still re-derives the Topic dropdown value from the saved parent_id via the ownerTopic lookup — the earlier round's finding is properly fixed (Content edit re-open showed Topic=TEST_MM_TopicA, Subtopic=TEST_QA_SubMulti).
Verified: curriculum override Topic dropdown lists ONLY topics tagged with the secondary curriculum (9 Money Masters topics, no Financial-Literacy-only topics leaked).

Note: a topic-level secondary curriculum saved without touching the grade selects persists an empty object (curriculum_overrides.money_entrepreneurship = {}), which correctly falls back to the item's own grade range. Behaviourally fine, but consider persisting the explicit min/max so later edits to the home grade range don't silently change the secondary curriculum's range.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: TEST_QA_SubMulti (subtopic under TEST_MM_TopicA, placed under TEST_MM_TopicB for Money Masters, grades 1-4), TEST_QA_ContentMulti (worksheet), TEST_QA_SingleFL topic + TEST_QA_SingleSub + TEST_QA_SingleContent. ALL DELETED and verified gone from Mongo. Pre-existing seed TEST_MM_TopicA (topic_b95bd4c173e4) and TEST_MM_TopicB (topic_3624882deb29) left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Detailed evidence per scenario: (A) SUBTOPIC DIALOG — Add Subtopic under TEST_MM_TopicA, ticking 'Money Masters & Entrepreneurship' renders data-testid=curriculum-override-money_entrepreneurship with Topic dropdown (only 9 MM-tagged topics incl. TEST_MM_TopicA/B) + Min/Max grade selects. Save without a topic -> toast 'Choose a topic for Money Masters & Entrepreneurship before saving' and dialog stays open (PASS). Picking TEST_MM_TopicB + grades 1st/4th saved ('Subtopic created'); re-opening edit-subtopic-<id> showed both curricula checked, Topic=TEST_MM_TopicB, Min=1st Grade, Max=4th Grade (PASS, no reset). (B) CONTENT — Add Content > Worksheet, title filled, MM ticked: Subtopic select shows placeholder 'Pick a topic first' and is disabled until a Topic is picked; save without placement -> toast 'Choose a topic & subtopic for Money Masters & Entrepreneurship before saving', dialog stays open; after Topic=TEST_MM_TopicA + Subtopic=TEST_QA_SubMulti -> 'Content created'; edit-content-<id> pre-filled both dropdowns correctly (PASS). Content rows live on the '3. Lesson Plan' tab (not on '4. Add Content'). (C) TREE GRAFTING — with Curriculum filter=Money Masters, TEST_QA_SubMulti moved out of TEST_MM_TopicA (0 subtopics) and appeared under TEST_MM_TopicB (1 subtopics); with 'All Curriculums' and 'Financial Literacy' it reverted to TEST_MM_TopicA (PASS both directions). (D) REGRESSION — FL-only Topic/Subtopic/Content each showed ZERO 'Placement for...' boxes and saved cleanly; grade filter 'Grade 3' narrowed 23->14 topic rows and restored; topic drag-and-drop reorder swapped rows with 'Topics reordered' toast and persisted, then restored, with zero console errors during that flow. Grade filter option labels are 'Grade 3' (not '3rd Grade') — relevant for selectors. Child/parent delivery pipeline was intentionally NOT tested (Phase 2, out of scope).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found this round. The only console error is a React setState-during-render warning caused by calling setSearchParams inside the setSelectedTopic/_setSelectedSubtopic state-updater callbacks; it does not affect the feature behaviour.
